question: How is franchise marketing different from regular marketing?
answer: Franchise marketing has to solve a problem regular marketing does not. A franchise brand operates dozens or hundreds of locations, each in a different market with a different competitor set and a different demand curve, but all under one brand identity. Generic agency playbooks treat every location like one big audience, which is why cost per lead climbs and franchisees complain about leads. Franchise marketing requires per-location targeting, local creative variants (especially UGC from real franchisees), centralized reporting so the franchisor sees performance across every market, and automated lead distribution to the right location in seconds. That is the system 5th Element Media builds.
